items.title: undefined-ui/second-brain-os
items.excerpt: An AI second brain that maintains itself. Full guide, starter vault, agent skills and scripts for a self-organizing knowledge base in Claude Code and Obsidian.
items.summary: undefined-ui describes a self-organizing knowledge base combining Claude Code with Obsidian, including agent skills, scripts, and starter vault for AI-assisted note management.
items.usefulness: Could help Python tool builders understand how to structure agentic workflows around document analysis and knowledge extraction for personal or organizational use.
items.to_verify: Whether the agent skills and self-organizing mechanisms work without manual intervention, and what document formats and sizes the system handles reliably.

items.title: Calling the AI bluff: Adding "Do not guess" cut made-up claims from 71% to 20%
items.summary: earnanhonestdollar reports testing a simple prompt instruction ('Do not guess') that reduced unsupported claims in model outputs from 71% to 20% in their benchmark.
items.usefulness: If the result holds across models and domains, this constraint could inform Python tool design for reducing hallucinations in document analysis or governance-related AI applications.
items.to_verify: Whether the 71% to 20% reduction persists across different model sizes, document domains, and whether the benchmark methodology and test set are disclosed.
